messages.text: Good morning, team! Quick heads up: we have new hires joining us in the next couple of weeks. Michelle in HR is finalizing start dates and I'll share the full list Monday. Please make them feel welcome.
Love hearing this! Do we know which teams they're landing on? Member Services has been stretched thin since the quarter-end rush.
Joanna, I expect at least one of them will be on the member services floor. Paul will have details on training schedules once the dates are locked.
Perfect. I can volunteer to shadow-buddy someone for the first week if that helps. Happy to walk them through the teller line and MemberCRM notes.
For anyone new coming through IT onboarding: I'm putting together a short guide on data access requests so people aren't waiting on tickets for days. Will post in #it once it's ready.
Are any of the new folks heading to Operations? Would be great to get another set of hands on settlements before the ACH volume picks up in October.
Larry, I'll confirm with Rita Solano, but I believe Operations is getting one new person. I'll make sure she loops you in on the training plan.
Great, thanks Gloria. I can put together a checklist of our daily recon steps so they can get up to speed faster.
Larry, if you share that checklist I can help turn it into something searchable. Could be a nice reference for everyone, not just new hires.
Deal, Amy. I'll send a draft early next week. A few steps in the ShareRecon process are still a bit tribal, so it'll be good to document them.
Reminder for the floor: let's plan a team lunch during the first week of new hires. Even a simple potluck helps people connect faster. Anyone want to organize?
Great idea, Joanna. The credit union will cover lunch for it. Pick a day that works for most schedules and let me know the headcount.
Wonderful, thank you! I'll set up a quick sign-up thread once we have the start dates confirmed.
Also, laptops and badge access for the new hires are being prepped. Andre's team has the equipment ready, so day one should go smoothly on the IT side.
Nice, that makes a big difference. Last time someone waited half a day for logins. Thanks to Andre's team for staying ahead of it.
Thanks, everyone, for being so proactive. This is exactly the kind of welcome I want our new colleagues to experience. Have a great weekend!
